decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the shopfront hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the new shop front shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface  between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - The works to raise the footway, to ensure level access to the shop, shall be carried out concurrently with the installation of the shop front, and shall be completed prior to the use of the shop commences.
description: Installation of new shop front to existing building.
